game.name: Army Of Two (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: A third-person strategic action game, Army Of Two on Xbox 360 puts you in command of Rios and Salem, two friends who have recently joined a private company recruiting mercenaries. The title is primarily based on the cooperative mode present throughout the game's various missions. Army of Two can also be played online, still in co-op mode.
